Container.Name: strata-supervisor
Container.Overview:
Web UI for Strata, the local LLM server for large mixture-of-experts models (Qwen, DeepSeek) on consumer GPUs. Built on the official Strata image: keep several model configs side by side and load or unload one at a time, only by hand. Nothing loads at container start, nothing swaps by itself. Strata downloads a model on its first load; your own GGUF files work too.
- Multi-GPU: one role per card (main, helper, off), also across different cards. - RAM mode per model: all experts in RAM, only what no card holds, a RAM budget, or straight from the model files. - OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API on port 8080 while a model is loaded.
Needs an NVIDIA GPU with the Nvidia-Driver plugin (driver 580.65 or newer) and "--gpus all" in Extra Parameters (set by default). Models are 60 to 190 GB each: put the Strata data path on a fast disk with room.
The web UI has no login: keep it on your LAN and set "Allowed host names".
Unofficial private project, not affiliated with the Strata project.
Container.Requires: An NVIDIA GPU, the Nvidia-Driver plugin (driver 580.65 or newer) and "--gpus all" in Extra Parameters. Lots of disk space for the models (60 to 190 GB each).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web UI. Change only the host port here; set UI_PORT only with host networking.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API of the loaded model. Without a model it answers 503.

Config.Name: Strata data
Config.Description: Models (60 to 190 GB each), Strata state and the API key. Put it on a fast disk with enough space.

Config.Name: Model configs
Config.Description: One TOML file per model config in models/, editable from the host.

Config.Name: Own GGUF files
Config.Description: Optional: a host folder with GGUF files you already have, one sub-folder per model. Pick a sub-folder in a model config under GGUF file. Writable, so the Models page can delete a folder; set it to read-only if the web UI should never delete there.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Key clients must send (16 characters or more). Empty: one is made once and kept in /data/state/api-key; the web UI shows it on request.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Recommended: the server's IP and name, comma separated, e.g. 192.168.1.10,tower. The web UI then answers only to these names, which stops other web pages from reaching it through DNS rebinding. Empty: any name.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the files the web UI writes in /config (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the files the web UI writes in /config (100 = users).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver features passed into the container.
